mapper.insert: INSERT INTO EG_ALRAM (MEM_ID, ALRAM_DATE, MESSAGE, TITLE) VALUES (#{mem_id}, #{alram_date}, #{message}, #{title})
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM EG_ALRAM WHERE MEM_ID = #{mem_id} AND READ_FLAG = 'N' ORDER BY ALRAM_IDX asc
mapper.update: UPDATE EG_ALRAM SET READ_FLAG = 'Y' WHERE ALRAM_IDX = #{alram_idx}
